evaluation: Post-hoc fixed-ROI image-count diagnostic from complete saved Main Test detector evaluation; not tracking or temporal state accuracy
population: All 184 frozen Main Test images, every one of 22 camera-specific fixed ROIs including zero-GT regions
confidence_rule: Keep stored post-NMS predictions with exported confidence >=0.35; no threshold tuning; check 6-significant-digit rounding margin
assignment: Same frozen bottom-centre geometry and zone-order boundary rule as Validation diagnostic; independently verify assignment
unit: One ROI-image pair, equally weighted; no image/ROI exclusions
missing_prediction_files: Reconstruct zero predictions for manifest images without TXT using completed 184-image run, new output directory, save_txt/save_conf enabled, and installed matching-version Ultralytics validator no_pred branch and nonempty-only save_txt; enumerate every missing name. Files are retained run artifacts, no separate original per-image empty-export manifest exists.
rounding: Check all kept predictions for boundary distance below worst-case coordinate-export rounding bounds; check threshold ambiguity. Report any ambiguity rather than silently choosing.
unchanged_selection: Old weights, old 0.35 choice and old ROI geometry frozen; no use of these results for selection
limits: 4 classes pooled; FP and FN can cancel in counts
Raw detector at evaluator image shape from retained run; application filters and ByteTrack absent
Regions use fixed existing layouts; this is not new-camera evaluation
Saved text boxes and confidence are rounded
Human GT boxes retained from original labels; no new AI or human labels
